messages:
maya_finance: Starting a shadow canary for the new pricing sheet tonight at 22:00 UTC. Objective: verify invoice math and reconciliation against current billing. Will be read-only.
ajit_sales: ack. what's the cohort mix and duration?
maya_finance: 5% traffic, evenly sampled across heavy and light customers, 48 hours. No customer-facing changes.
sasha_product: Confirm grandfathering behavior in shadow? We can't surface legacy customers as changed.
maya_finance: Yes. Shadow honors grandfathering flags. Config snippet: pricing_experiment cohort=shadow grandfathered_tiers=[legacy_monthly,reserved_v1] exclude_labels=[promo_exempt]. Full config in runbook.
li_engineering: I can route traffic to the billing simulator. Which feature flag name should I use?
maya_finance: pricing_shadow_2026Q1. We'll flip at 21:50 UTC.
nora_ops: Ops note: raise alert if invoice mismatch > 0.5% for top 200 accounts. billingbot will post hourly diffs.
billingbot: Scheduled job: shadow-billing-compare runs hourly and posts delta report to the dashboard. First check 22:05 UTC.
carlos_revenue_ops: Heads up: Stripe settlements can lag. Hourly noise expected; rely on 24h aggregates for final decisions.
sasha_product: Legal wants promo-exempt customers excluded from signal to avoid false positives.
maya_finance: Done. exclude_labels includes promo_exempt.
ajit_sales: Any approval gates for grandfathering exceptions? Need director signoff for changes outside existing list. @maya_finance will you escalate after results?
maya_finance: Yes. Will post 24h and 48h summaries and request approvals if deltas exceed thresholds. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runs/shadow-pricing-205500 (contains dashboards, checklist, rollback steps).
legalbot: Note: If revenue-impact delta > 1% we require legal review before rollout.
carlos_revenue_ops: If usage patterns shift, recommend staged A/B at 10% then 25% before full release.
li_engineering: I'll be on call for the first 3 hours to monitor billing pipeline and latency.
maya_finance: Thanks. I'll update this thread with hourly reports.
